digest.component_or_area: core CAS push delivery and workflow orchestration
propositions: Duplicate CAS push and retry logic across workflows is consolidated into a single Python core owner at src/rebar/_store/push.py with strict and best-effort delivery modes.
The push_tickets_branch and commit_and_push_tickets_branch entrypoints implement CAS retry budget, fetch-and-merge recovery, and terminal push delivery in a reusable Python API.

Workflow YAML is simplified to orchestration only; reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows delegate delivery once each through Python strict adapters instead of maintaining their own fetch/merge/retry loops.
Legacy Python library, CLI, MCP, importer, and ticket-store callers preserve best-effort defaults with no forced strictness; strictness is explicit and opt-in only at workflow boundaries.
Strict delivery raises PushDeliveryError with typed failure reason and unpushed-commit count; best-effort delivery retains established return and disposition contracts for backward compatibility.
